$comment: Plain English for every hosting reason code the contract declares (omx-contract data/hosting/*.json, rendered as the HOSTING_*_CODES of openmixer's packages/declarations/omx-contract/omx-contract.d.ts) and a qualifier, a host or the console emits. {name} is the reason's parameter; {name:pct} prints a core fraction as a percentage. A run file's reason.text is rendered from this table; a code missing here fails the build.

codes.hosting.stability.soaked: Ran the full lifecycle and the show-length soak ({soakSeconds} s) without a fault.
codes.hosting.stability.crashed-attributed-plu: Crashed under test, and the crash signature points into the plugin's own binary.
codes.hosting.stability.crashed-live-on-this-r: Crashed while hosted on the test console.
codes.hosting.stability.cycles-below-floor: Ran {cycles} load/run/unload cycles; {floor} are required before stability counts as measured.
codes.hosting.stability.unsoaked: Soaked for {soakSeconds} s; {required} s are required before stability counts as measured.
codes.hosting.stability.crash-unattributed: A crash was observed that could not be attributed to the plugin or the host.
codes.hosting.stability.spawns-threads: Starts {threads} thread(s) of its own when loaded.
codes.hosting.stability.links-gui-toolkit: Links a GUI toolkit into the audio process.
codes.hosting.rt-safety.clean-under-sweep: No allocation, lock or system call in the audio callback over {blocks} blocks.
codes.hosting.rt-safety.violations-in-run: In the audio callback: {allocations} allocation(s), {locks} lock(s), {syscalls} system call(s).
codes.hosting.rt-safety.unmeasured: Real-time safety has not been measured.
codes.hosting.rt-safety.not-reproducible: Real-time safety readings differed between repeats.
codes.hosting.features.all-provided: Every feature the plugin requires is provided by the host.
codes.hosting.features.required-not-provided: Requires features the host does not provide: {features}.
codes.hosting.features.host-not-provided: Requires features the host cannot provide in-process: {features}.
codes.hosting.features.cv-ports: Has CV ports, which the console does not feed.
codes.hosting.features.midi-in-fed-empty: Has a MIDI input; the console feeds it no events.
codes.hosting.features.scan-predates-field: The scan that described this plugin predates the features field.
codes.hosting.cost.within-ceiling: CPU cost {coreFractionP95:pct} of a core at the 95th percentile (limit {ceiling:pct}).
codes.hosting.cost.above-ceiling: CPU cost {coreFractionP95:pct} of a core at the 95th percentile, above the limit of {ceiling:pct}.
codes.hosting.cost.spiky-tail: CPU cost has a long tail: the 95th percentile is {tailRatio}× the median (limit {ceiling}×).
codes.hosting.cost.unmeasured-at-rate-and-quan: CPU cost has not been measured at {rate} Hz and {quantum} frames.
codes.hosting.latency.resolved: Reported latency matches the measured latency.
codes.hosting.latency.nonconforming: Reported latency does not match the measured latency.
codes.hosting.latency.parameter-dependent: Latency changes with the plugin's settings.
codes.hosting.topology.matched: {ins} audio input(s), {outs} output(s): fits a channel strip.
codes.hosting.topology.extra-inputs-fed-silenc: {ins} audio inputs for {outs} outputs; the extra inputs are fed silence.
codes.hosting.topology.wider-than-strip: {ins} inputs, {outs} outputs: wider than a stereo strip.
codes.hosting.clap.latency-mismatch: At {rate} Hz the plugin declares {declared} frames of latency and {measured} were measured.
codes.hosting.clap.not-audio-effect: Does not declare the audio-effect feature (declares: {features}).
codes.hosting.clap.headless-failed: Could not run without its user interface.
codes.hosting.clap.thread-violation: Called {violations} function(s) from the wrong thread.
codes.hosting.clap.unqualified: The CLAP qualifier has not measured this plugin.
codes.hosting.override.curator-isolated: Set to run isolated by the catalog curator.
codes.hosting.provenance.host-differs: Measured on {measuredOn}, but the console runs on {runningOn}.
codes.hosting.provenance.sweep-control-did-not: The test run's own control case did not trigger, so no figure from that run counts.
codes.hosting.disabled: In-process hosting is switched off on the console.
codes.hosting.unjudged: Not judged: the console has not observed a rate and quantum.
codes.hosting.no-realisation: Qualified for in-process hosting, which the console does not offer yet.
codes.hosting.linked: Runs linked into the engine's own process.
codes.hosting.stability.soak-failed-at-rate: The show-length soak failed at {rate} Hz: {failure}.
codes.hosting.rt-safety.clean-under-notes: No allocations, locks or system calls in the audio callback while notes were played.
codes.hosting.rt-safety.violations-under-notes: Allocated, locked or made system calls in the audio callback while notes were played.
codes.hosting.rt-safety.notes-unmeasured: Real-time safety under note input has not been measured.
codes.hosting.features.missing: Requires a host feature that is not offered, so it is refused when added.
codes.hosting.features.atom-in-unfed: Has a non-MIDI atom input that no buffer here can feed.
codes.hosting.features.ports-unreadable: Declares ports its reader cannot read (a port shared by several plugins of one bundle, or a port with no symbol), so none reaches the host; the bundle's data is at fault, not its layout.
codes.hosting.cost.fields-missing: The cost measurement lacks fields, so no cost verdict is given.
codes.hosting.topology.instrument: Declares itself an instrument rather than an effect.
codes.hosting.topology.too-many-ports: {ins} inputs and {outs} outputs: more auxiliary ports on one side than the limit, or more than one main port on a side.
codes.hosting.topology.port-too-wide: A port has more channels than the limit, or an ambisonic port's channel count is not (order + 1) squared.
codes.hosting.topology.channel-map-unknown: A surround port names a channel the host does not know, or refuses the carrier's channel mask.
codes.hosting.topology.ambisonic-config: An ambisonic port refuses the carrier's channel ordering or normalisation.
codes.hosting.clap.extensions-not-covered: Requires CLAP extensions the host does not cover.
codes.hosting.clap.format-not-hosted: The CLAP format is not hosted on this console.
codes.hosting.worker.nonconforming: Its worker does not conform to the host's worker contract.
codes.hosting.idle.hold-refused: The CPU idle-state hold could not be taken (the device could not be opened for writing: no permission, or no such device); the host runs without it.
codes.hosting.window.no-display: No display to show the plugin's window on (none is named, or the display server refused the connection); the plugin runs on without it.
codes.hosting.window.refused: The plugin's GUI answered no when asked to create, embed or show its window.
codes.hosting.window.unsupported: The plugin has no GUI, or offers no window API the host can show, embedded or floating.
codes.hosting.state.unreadable: The plugin's saved state could not be read or applied.
codes.hosting.state.not-a-copy: A state path is not inside a save's copy directory of the state root.
codes.hosting.state.path-on-audio: A state path was requested from the audio thread.
codes.hosting.state.path-outside: A state path is empty, absolute, or climbs out of its directory with a `..` component.
codes.hosting.state.path-symlink: A component of a state path is a symbolic link.
codes.hosting.state.path-too-long: A state path reaches the system's maximum length, or one of its components is too long.
codes.hosting.state.path-unmakeable: A directory of a state path could not be made.
codes.hosting.patch.not-writable: A text property write named a property the plugin does not have.
codes.hosting.patch.too-large: A text property value was longer than the plugin's text limit.
codes.hosting.patch.busy: A text property write was refused while the previous write still waits for its audio block.
codes.hosting.preset.not-found: The preset asked for does not exist for this plugin.
codes.hosting.resource-hints.unknown-hint: The declared resource-hint mask sets a bit no known hint uses.
codes.hosting.resource-hints.out-of-range: A resource hint carries a figure below zero, or past what the hint holds.
codes.hosting.resource-hints.wrong-unit: A resource hint carries a figure not in its unit: a flag that is not a boolean, or a count, time or size that is not an integer.
